frontMatter.title: Badminton Weekly Round-Up: Big Wins and Big Finals
frontMatter.summary: A strong week for Navan badminton with a 4–0 win for the Grade 7 Ladies and a runners-up finish for Grade 2 Mixed 'A'. Plenty of league and cup action ahead as the season nears its climax.

prev.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont: Navan vs Loughegar & Navan vs Ardee + Social Badminton
prev.summary: Thursday Club Night is on at Claremont with Grade 4 Mens (Navan vs Loughegar) and Grade 7 Ladies (Navan vs Ardee), followed by two courts of social badminton from 9:30pm.
